snippet.title: Pick a Part | Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
🐌✨ Pick a Part Demo is OUT NOW on Steam! ✨🐌
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5242440/Pick_a_Part_Demo/

Clean dirty items and sell them to the locals, in the post-post-apocalyptic world of Pick a Part! Join Sprout, the newcomer of a small island, where she has to manage her store and gain the trust of the town.

🔹 Clean and restore ancient items
🔹 Pick them apart and put them back together
🔹 Explore a tiny island and meet odd locals
🔹 Manage your little antique shop and keep it nice and tidy

Press inquiries: contact@kiwickstudios.com
Join our Discord: https://discord.gg/asSmUHU3vH

#PickAPart #IndieGameLaunch #WishlistNow #StoryDrivenGames #CozyGame #SteamDemo #GameDev #IndieDev
